name: codex-cli
label: Codex CLI / Desktop
description: Production-supported runtime adapter for AIKit in Codex CLI / Desktop. Reuses core agents, manifests and routing through workspace install/update flow and runtime-specific entrypoints.

graph_execution.purpose: Codex runtime can inspect packaged workflow DAG metadata and future graph-aware orchestration hints directly from the installed workspace.

runtime_entrypoints.name: codex-runtime-guide
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Runtime-specific AIKit instructions for Codex workspaces.

runtime_entrypoints.name: continue-maintainer
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Continue developing AIKit inside Codex using the maintainer handoff prompt.

runtime_entrypoints.name: codex-command-surface
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Codex-native command surface combining packaged AIKit skills with command-first runtime workspace lifecycle, bootstrap and bounded audit commands.

runtime_entrypoints.name: codex-native-agents
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Codex-native mirror of packaged AIKit agents for workspace inspection and runtime handoff.

runtime_entrypoints.name: codex-native-skills
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Codex-native mirror of packaged AIKit skills alongside slash command files.

runtime_entrypoints.name: codex-native-memory
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Codex-native mirror of canonical AIKit memory so installed workspaces do not look Claude-only.

runtime_entrypoints.name: packaged-agents
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Canonical maintainer agent packaged for Codex runtime.

runtime_entrypoints.name: runtime-operating-protocol
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Rules for Codex agents to choose internal AIKit tools, memory updates and RAG refreshes without exposing scripts as the primary user interface.

runtime_entrypoints.name: runtime-continuation-contract
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Rules for resumed flows, bundle handoff, session lineage and next-step orchestration in Codex workspaces.

runtime_entrypoints.name: runtime-tools-registry
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Machine-readable registry of internal AIKit tools Codex agents can use for orchestration, memory, RAG and validation.

runtime_entrypoints.name: mcp-tool-plane
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Runtime-native MCP provider matrix for Codex agents, keeping Figma/GitHub tools separate from local shell commands.

notes: Core workflows should be reused, not rewritten
Uses workspace install flow through scripts/install-adapter-package.py
Production-supported runtime through workspace update flow
